title: She Screamed To Get Me Fired. I Audit This Store.
script: I was doing an incognito compliance walkthrough at a hardware store in a borrowed vest so I wouldn't stand out, checking aisle safety hours before the real inspection team was due. A customer decided I was the worst employee alive for not knowing which aisle had grout sealant, and when I calmly offered to find someone who actually worked there, she started filming, announcing to her camera that she was getting me fired and posting it for her twelve thousand followers. The store manager walked over mid-rant, recognized my badge instantly, and asked, loudly enough for her phone to catch it, whether corporate's hazard inspection was going well. She lowered the phone but never took the video down, and it stayed up three days before someone in her own comments recognized the audit badge and asked why she was trying to get a state inspector fired. Corporate's report never mentioned her name once. Her followers did.
